darshitpp-x-agent-agy.description: Delegate tasks or get a second opinion from Antigravity CLI (agy). Infers mode (delegation vs validation) from prompt context. Detects available models at runtime via the CLI. Use when cross-validating code, plans, or architecture with Antigravity (agy), or offloading work to it. Do not use for tasks that do not benefit from cross-model input.
